round: Second research round after the overnight search; new series3 run IDs
primary_question: When and why does quantization alter reasoning completion, and how do recurrence, calibration and representation contribute?

remote.deadline_rule: Minimum of controller start plus 12 hours and verified account/scheduler expiry minus finalization reserve
remote.access_check: SSH renewal and current allocation check required before launch

priority_interventions: Variable-loop research checkpoint: one versus three passes, each at native/four/two-bit FFN representation
Separate completed-answer accuracy from reasoning completion and transition-token behavior
First-pass versus all-pass calibration at matched sampled token-visit count
Dense-control replication on Qwen3-8B; optional non-looped MoE extension
One metadata-dtype ablation and optional native MLX portability check
required_controls: Variable-loop checkpoint native baseline at each tested depth
Production Mini archived/source baseline for continuity
gate_three_bit_import: Exact MLX packing/dequantization parity; old bridge's 32//bits decoder is insufficient
old_records_and_models: Immutable; new scorer, data, numerical implementation and caches get new hashes and directories
not_implemented_yet: per-pass activation sampling at matched observation count
dense control adapters and parity checks

practical_admission.applies_to: Optional deployment conclusion only; not a criterion for scientific success

primary_goal: Scientific explanation and controlled measurement across models; Mac deployment is optional secondary validation
secondary_deployment_interventions: Identical E4 packed codes with expert affine scales and offsets rounded from FP32 to BF16
Restore eight-bit embeddings and output head at fixed expert metadata policy
Compare equally sized looped-layer and tail-layer protection
Optional tested blockwise Hessian error compensation only if time and resources permit

research_panel.quantization_scope: FFN/expert matrices, fixed group size and declared metadata policy
research_panel.cross_model_architecture_claims: Associations only; heterogeneous training/size/source precision prevent architecture-only causal claims
research_panel.novelty: Not established; targeted replication/extension of existing literature

site_blocker.required_to_resume: A valid authorized allocation after maintenance ends, or another authorized GPU resource
